sentence: The system shall provide email notifications for critical events.
The application shall support role-based access control.
The system shall load any page within 3 seconds on a standard connection.
The system shall provide failover capability for critical components.
The system must protect user data from unauthorized disclosure.
The system shall support horizontal scaling by adding more server instances.
The application must use parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection.
The system must scan uploaded files for malware before processing.
The application must provide users with the ability to request data deletion.
The application shall support hot-standby configuration.
The system must prevent unauthorized access to administrative functions.
The system shall provide integration with popular productivity tools.
The application must perform input sanitization on all user data.
The system shall respond to user requests within 2 seconds under normal load.
System administrators shall be able to deploy updates without service interruption.
The system must enforce session timeout after 30 minutes of inactivity.
The application must protect against brute force login attempts.
Users shall be able to create and manage projects.
Users shall be able to manage their notification settings.
The application shall minimize downtime during updates.
